inherited_M6_cost.note: Includes profiles/labels/predictors in this pilot. Earlier test/failed-check costs are separate check records; no total CPU-hours claim.

accounting_limit: Wall times can overlap and are not CPU time. Test training/forward totals are uninstrumented. Proposal/call counts are derived from frozen kernel control flow. Predictor support/fallback work is included in stage/inference wall time; all 32 deployed M7 predictor decisions fell back before the MLP. Historical M6 training/label/fitting costs are inherited separately, not charged repeatedly.
